question_cn: 白方在法国防御中建立了e5空间优势。为什么空间优势如果没有具体的跟进计划，反而可能成为负担？
question_en: White has gained space with e5 in the French Defense. Why can this advantage become a burden without a concrete follow-up plan?

options.text_cn: 空间优势本身就已经足够决定胜负，不需要后续计划
options.text_en: The space advantage alone decides the game; no follow-up is needed.

options.text_cn: 超前的兵形成弱点，若无力维持或转化为进攻，对方反击时这些兵可能成为攻击目标
options.text_en: Advanced pawns can become targets if they cannot be supported or turned into an attack.

options.text_cn: 空间优势只在残局有价值，开局中不需要跟进
options.text_en: Space matters only in the endgame, so no opening follow-up is needed.

options.text_cn: 跟进计划让子力离开中心，反而更弱
options.text_en: A follow-up plan takes pieces away from the center and weakens the position.

explanation_cn: 空间优势是动态资源，必须「变现」才有价值。超前的兵（如e5）需要后续子力配合才能维持：若白方无法跟进（如缺乏Be3+Qd2+O-O-O的配套计划），e5兵反而成为突出弱点，随时被…f6攻击。空间优势若无目标则是负担，因为维持这些兵需要消耗守备资源。有空间优势的一方必须立刻制定进攻计划并付诸实施，否则等对方稳定后局面会趋于平衡甚至逆转。
explanation_en: A space advantage is a dynamic resource that must be converted into something concrete. Advanced pawns such as e5 need piece support; without a plan, they may become targets for ...f6. Maintaining them also consumes defensive resources. The side with more space should develop a clear plan and act before the opponent stabilizes, or the advantage may fade or even reverse.
